meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Business of scheduled banks in India by bank group (commercial, co-operative) on a reporting Friday of every month since 2005: deposits, borrowings, credit, investments, cash (Statistical Tables Relating to Banks; also report 937)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 639 (data provider DP2), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore.
